name: gmail-2-trello
description: Gmail+Trello integration. Extension for Chrome browser and other developments.

scripts.dev: echo '🚀 Development Setup: 1) Open chrome://extensions/ 2) Enable Developer mode 3) Load unpacked: chrome_manifest_v3/ 4) Go to Gmail to test'
scripts.build: npm run lint:fix && npm run format && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && cd chrome_manifest_v3 && zip -r ../gmail-2-trello-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check

author: Andrew Coven <acoven>
